name: Uragoi
source:
[i]"I am Uragoi, the jorōgumo. I own of a candy store, and from this day onwards, I'll own you too!❤️"[/i]

The woman who's had her eyes on you(♀) ever since you wandered into this strange world.

Selfish and overbearing, Uragoi treats humans like disposable toys. Having been captured, you are now being forced to go on a date with her.

Her true form is that of the arachnid jorōgumo. She's after the blood coursing through your veins, which she senses is special. 

She's owns a candy store, but the shop only sporadically opens for business. The candy sold there imparts her with the ability to manipulate the mind of whoever consumes it. 

#selfish_lady
#surprisingly_stubborn
#163cm_tall
#she_clearly_wants_to_kill_you

[i]"You're fucking scared of me, aren't you. But here you are, saying all these sweet nothings. You're not just leading me on, right?"[/i]

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/pukari_ukiwa/status/1959197488076009838]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
